pt-br:engines.hideHint.note: Rule 7: “Tira” does not match the você imperative used elsewhere.

pt-br:engines.hiddenHint.text: Fora de todas as listas de modelos. Os apps e logins deles não mudam.
pt-br:engines.hiddenHint.en: Left out of every model list. Their apps and sign-ins are unchanged.

pt-br:engines.copilot.preview.text: O GitHub Copilot roda pela sua própria Copilot CLI, com o seu login do GitHub e o seu plano do Copilot. O GitHub chama o modo ACP de prévia pública.
pt-br:engines.copilot.preview.en: GitHub Copilot runs through your own Copilot CLI, with your GitHub sign-in and Copilot plan. GitHub calls its ACP mode a public preview.
pt-br:engines.copilot.preview.note: Rule 1: CLI and modo ACP are unexplained technical terms.

pt-br:engines.copilot.install.text: O Murage não instala a GitHub Copilot CLI. Instale com as instruções do próprio GitHub abaixo e depois verifique de novo.
pt-br:engines.copilot.install.en: Murage does not install GitHub Copilot CLI. Install it with GitHub's own instructions below, then check again.

pt-br:media.local.onlyWorkspace.text: Só imagens da pasta desta conversa são carregadas aqui.
pt-br:media.local.onlyWorkspace.en: Only pictures in this conversation's folder load here.

pt-br:media.local.desktopOnly.text: As imagens da pasta do bot não estão disponíveis nesta interface.
pt-br:media.local.desktopOnly.en: Pictures from the bot's folder are not available on this surface.

pt-br:media.local.missing.text: Essa imagem não está na pasta desta conversa agora.
pt-br:media.local.missing.en: That picture is not in this conversation's folder right now.

pt-br:media.local.changed.text: Essa imagem mudou ou não pôde ser carregada.
pt-br:media.local.changed.en: That picture changed or could not be loaded.

pt-br:media.local.denied.text: Esse arquivo não está disponível nesta conversa.
pt-br:media.local.denied.en: That file is not available from this conversation.

pt-br:media.local.unsupported.text: O Murage não pode mostrar este arquivo como imagem.
pt-br:media.local.unsupported.en: Murage can't show this file as a picture.

pt-br:media.local.unreachable.text: O Murage não consegue acessar essa imagem agora.
pt-br:media.local.unreachable.en: Murage can't reach that picture right now.

pt-br:media.local.changedShown.text: Essa imagem mudou. Esta é a versão atual.
pt-br:media.local.changedShown.en: That picture changed. This is the current version.

pt-br:media.local.budget.text: Outras imagens estão usando o espaço de prévia.
pt-br:media.local.budget.en: Other pictures are using the preview space.

pt-br:media.local.saveBusy.text: Outra imagem está sendo salva. Tente novamente em breve.
pt-br:media.local.saveBusy.en: Another picture is being saved. Try again shortly.

pt-br:call.budgetStop.text: A chamada terminou porque esta chave do Flux atingiu seu orçamento. Ela começa de novo quando o orçamento é redefinido ou alterado.
pt-br:call.budgetStop.en: The call ended because this Flux key has reached its budget. It starts again when the budget resets or changes.

pt-br:voice.budgetReached.text: A voz está pausada: esta chave do Flux atingiu o orçamento. Ela será retomada quando o orçamento mudar.
pt-br:voice.budgetReached.en: Voice is paused: this Flux key has reached its budget. It starts again when the budget changes.

pt-br:chats.previews.partial.text: As prévias das conversas ainda estão sendo preparadas.
pt-br:chats.previews.partial.en: Chat previews are still getting ready.

zh:engines.cloud.localOnly.text: {engine} 在你的电脑上运行。请在你的电脑上打开 Murage 来使用它。
zh:engines.cloud.localOnly.en: {engine} runs on your computer. Open Murage on your computer to use it.

zh:engines.hideHint.text: 把这个引擎从所有模型列表中移除。它的应用和登录保持不变，你可以在下方取消隐藏。
zh:engines.hideHint.en: Leave this engine out of every model list. Its app and sign-in stay as they are, and you can unhide it below.

zh:engines.hiddenHint.text: 不会出现在任何模型列表中。它们的应用和登录不变。
zh:engines.hiddenHint.en: Left out of every model list. Their apps and sign-ins are unchanged.

zh:engines.copilot.preview.text: GitHub Copilot 通过你自己的 Copilot CLI 运行，使用你的 GitHub 登录和 Copilot 套餐。GitHub 将其 ACP 模式称为公开预览。
zh:engines.copilot.preview.en: GitHub Copilot runs through your own Copilot CLI, with your GitHub sign-in and Copilot plan. GitHub calls its ACP mode a public preview.
zh:engines.copilot.preview.note: Rule 1: CLI and ACP mode are unexplained technical terms.

zh:engines.copilot.install.text: Murage 不会安装 GitHub Copilot CLI。请按照下方 GitHub 自己的说明安装，然后再检查一次。
zh:engines.copilot.install.en: Murage does not install GitHub Copilot CLI. Install it with GitHub's own instructions below, then check again.

zh:media.local.onlyWorkspace.text: 这里只加载此对话文件夹中的图片。
zh:media.local.onlyWorkspace.en: Only pictures in this conversation's folder load here.

zh:media.local.desktopOnly.text: 此界面无法使用机器人文件夹中的图片。
zh:media.local.desktopOnly.en: Pictures from the bot's folder are not available on this surface.

zh:media.local.missing.text: 该图片目前不在此对话的文件夹中。
zh:media.local.missing.en: That picture is not in this conversation's folder right now.

zh:media.local.changed.text: 该图片已更改或无法加载。
zh:media.local.changed.en: That picture changed or could not be loaded.

zh:media.local.denied.text: 此对话无法使用该文件。
zh:media.local.denied.en: That file is not available from this conversation.

zh:media.local.unsupported.text: Murage 无法将此文件显示为图片。
zh:media.local.unsupported.en: Murage can't show this file as a picture.

zh:media.local.unreachable.text: Murage 目前无法访问该图片。
zh:media.local.unreachable.en: Murage can't reach that picture right now.

zh:media.local.changedShown.text: 该图片已更改。这是当前版本。
zh:media.local.changedShown.en: That picture changed. This is the current version.

zh:media.local.budget.text: 其他图片正在使用预览空间。
zh:media.local.budget.en: Other pictures are using the preview space.

zh:media.local.saveBusy.text: 正在保存另一张图片。请稍后重试。
zh:media.local.saveBusy.en: Another picture is being saved. Try again shortly.

zh:call.budgetStop.text: 此 Flux 密钥已达到预算，因此通话已结束。预算重置或更改后，可以再次开始通话。
zh:call.budgetStop.en: The call ended because this Flux key has reached its budget. It starts again when the budget resets or changes.
zh:call.budgetStop.note: Rule 5: The translation says the user can restart the call instead of saying it restarts.

zh:voice.budgetReached.text: 语音已暂停：此 Flux 密钥已达到预算上限。预算变更后会恢复。
zh:voice.budgetReached.en: Voice is paused: this Flux key has reached its budget. It starts again when the budget changes.

zh:chats.previews.partial.en: Chat previews are still getting ready.
